subject: English First Additional Language

source.subtopic: Week 6: introduces /a/ (ant, apple, axe, animal) with the song 'ants on my arm'

show.line: Listen. a, a, ant. Ants on my arm! Ant starts with a.

rounds.prompt: Which one starts with a, as in ant?
Say the sound with me. a, as in ant!
Tap the letter that says a.
Does it start with a? Sort the pictures.

hints: Open your mouth wide. a, a, ant.
Say the word slowly. Listen to the first sound.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! I will find a word that starts with a.
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! Bed starts with b. Apple starts with a.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's listen together. a, a, apple. Apple starts with a!

parent_line: Can hear and say the a sound at the start of words like ant and apple.
